sources.nextReviewTrigger: Approval, pause, rejection, or resumable-run semantics change

semantic.summary: The current guide supports fail-closed argument review, pause/approve/reject/resume and trusted server-owned pending state. Approvals for local shell/file tools are opt-in; persistent decisions can span agents and executors. The handbook per-action, argument-specific approval policy must be enforced explicitly rather than assumed from SDK defaults.

sources.nextReviewTrigger: Tracing defaults, span types, privacy controls, or export behavior changes

semantic.summary: Tracing still covers model, tool, handoff and guardrail events and includes sensitive data by default. The guide requires replacing default processors with an application-owned fail-closed redacting exporter when export depends on redaction; adding a processor leaves the default exporter active. This supports the handbook pre-export redaction rule.
